items.text: Survey desktop, web and mobile component usage
Install HeroUI 3 and learn its v3 API
Wire HeroUI styles and theme tokens into both stylesheets
Rewrite web shared ui.jsx on HeroUI primitives
Rewrite desktop ui.jsx and SelectField on HeroUI
Convert web views and components to HeroUI
Convert desktop renderer controls to HeroUI
Remove Flowbite, update the two stale test assertions and the docs
Build desktop, web and mobile bundles
Run npm test and verify HeroUI on all three targets in the browser and the desktop window
